The '''1983–84 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], seven points ahead of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] and [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]] were relegated.
